shade.description: green translucent leaf-colored slime from reference top-left
shade.action: compress low to store force; spring into a long forward headbutt towards screen-left, eyes fierce; recoil into a squashed landing

imp.description: green goblin, short steel sword in right hand and round wooden shield, reference top-middle
imp.action: pull sword arm far back with bent elbow; lunge and extend sword forward-left with a clear slash and shield guarding; retract sword with knees bent

fairy.description: yellow black giant bee with ivory wings, reference top-right
fairy.action: curl abdomen back and spread wings high; thrust abdomen and stinger forward-left in a diving strike, wings swept back; lift wings and retract abdomen

beetle.action: raise front body and open mandibles widely; drive front legs and mandibles down-forward into a slam; push torso back to ready

bat.description: brown stocky bristled tusked boar reference middle-middle
bat.action: brace hind legs and lower head; fully extend hind legs while driving tusks forward-left in a charging hit; plant front hooves and lift head

mole.description: green muscular orc with wooden club and dark metal shoulder armor reference middle-right
mole.action: lift club clearly above and behind head with bent elbows; slam club diagonally down-left past body, torso bends with strike; lift club back halfway and regain stance

clockwork.description: ivory brass clockwork soldier with spear and round shield reference bottom-left
clockwork.action: draw spear hand back and guard with shield; thrust spear fully forward-left with arm and shoulders extending; pull spear back halfway

spellbook.description: brass spherical hovering drone, twin propellers and blue central lens reference bottom-middle
spellbook.action: tilt housing back and expose glowing blue emitter aperture; pitch forward and discharge a small blue muzzle flare leftwards, side mechanisms extending; retract emitter and settle level

fox.action: lower front shoulders, open jaw and crouch hind legs; pounce forward-left with extended forelegs and snapping jaws; plant forepaws with head drawn back

ember_slime.action: compress low and gather fire at mouth; stretch body forward-left and spit one compact orange fire burst; recoil body back low

frost_slime.description: blue ice slime with white snowflake markings and crystals reference top-middle
frost_slime.action: squash low, crystals cant forward; extend icy body and release one small cyan ice shard leftwards; reform low rounded body

cave_bat.description: purple bat with yellow eyes reference top-right
cave_bat.action: spread wings high, arch neck back and open jaw; snap wings down and stretch head forward-left in biting dive; wings sweep up and knees tuck

rat.description: brown rat with pink tail reference second-row left
rat.action: crouch low with jaw opening; leap forward-left, forepaws extend and incisors bite; land with legs bent

spider.description: purple eight-legged spider with clustered yellow eyes reference second-row middle
spider.action: lift front pair of legs and open fangs; thrust head and front legs forward-left with a small silk jet; retract legs and head

goblin_archer.description: green hooded goblin archer with brown bow and quiver reference second-row right
goblin_archer.action: nock arrow and draw string visibly to cheek, bow bends; release string with bow hand pointing left and arrow just leaving bow; lower bow and reach to quiver

goblin_shaman.description: teal-hooded green goblin shaman, blue crystal staff reference third-row left
goblin_shaman.action: raise staff up-back and gather a small cyan orb in free palm; point staff and extend free hand forward-left releasing spell; retract arm and lower staff

orc_axeman.description: green orc with large single axe and gray shoulder armor reference third-row middle
orc_axeman.action: raise axe behind shoulder using both hands; swing axe strongly down-left across torso with planted feet; recover axe halfway upright

skeleton.description: helmeted skeleton with sword and round shield reference third-row right
skeleton.action: draw sword behind ribs and raise shield; step into a forward-left sword thrust, elbow straight; retract sword and settle stance

goblin_captain.description: red-hooded goblin captain with sword and large round shield reference bottom-left
goblin_captain.action: wind sword arm behind shoulder while shield moves forward; powerful forward-left slashing lunge with torso rotation; recover sword back into guard

orc_champion.description: huge green armored orc champion with large axe reference bottom-middle
orc_champion.action: brace legs wide and raise axe high over head; drive axe down-left with bent torso and extending elbows; pull axe upward to recover

centurion.description: gold ivory mechanical centurion with spear and tall blue-gold shield reference bottom-right
centurion.action: pull spear back alongside shoulder; step and thrust long spear hard forward-left, shield tilted; retract spear and return weight

warden.description: massive antlered tree golem with flowers and blue chest rune, reference first row
warden.action: raise both enormous fists above head; slam both fists onto ground ahead-left with bent shoulders and knees; lift fists halfway after impact

golem.description: massive gray stone golem with cyan crystals and blue chest rune reference second row
golem.action: twist torso and draw huge fist overhead; smash fist forward-left into ground with full shoulder extension; pull fist up and straighten

sentinel.description: huge ivory golden armored knight with luminous blue emblems, sword and shield reference third row
sentinel.action: lift long sword up and behind helmet; cleave sword down-left with shield held back, body clearly lunging; bring sword back upward toward guard

flood_rustclaw_crab.description: teal crab with rusty brass gauntlet claws and barnacles, reference left column
flood_rustclaw_crab.action: pull giant claw up-back and open pincers; swing claw down-forward-left and clamp hard; retract claw half-open

flood_bell_nautilus.description: brass spiral-shelled blue nautilus with cannon siphon and tentacles, reference middle column
flood_bell_nautilus.action: curl tentacles tightly and draw siphon in; thrust siphon left and extend tentacles with compact water muzzle spray; draw siphon back

flood_bastion_tortoise.description: gray armored tortoise carrying a stone fortress, reference right column
flood_bastion_tortoise.action: brace hind legs and lift foreleg, neck draws back; drive head and foreleg forward-left with jaw open, shell tips slightly; lower foreleg and retract neck

spore_blade_cricket.description: blade-mandibled cave cricket reference left column
spore_blade_cricket.action: fold blade forelimbs back and compress hind legs; spring forward-left with mandibles and forelimbs fully extended; fold legs into landing

spore_lantern_moth.description: spore lantern moth reference middle column
spore_lantern_moth.action: raise wings and curl luminous abdomen; beat wings down and project a compact spore puff leftwards; lift wings and uncoil

spore_crown_toad.description: mushroom-crowned heavy toad reference right column
spore_crown_toad.action: crouch hind legs and inflate throat; open mouth and lash tongue straight leftward, torso lunges; retract tongue and lower body

lava_coal_salamander.action: crouch legs, arch neck and pull jaw back; extend neck and open jaws projecting compact ember breath leftward; close jaw and settle

lava_vent_snail.description: volcanic vent-shell snail reference middle column
lava_vent_snail.action: compress body and pull head in, shell vent glows; head shoots forward-left and vent releases a small pressure puff; head recoils and vent dims

lava_obsidian_rhino.description: obsidian-horn armored rhinoceros reference right column
lava_obsidian_rhino.action: brace legs and lower horn, hindquarters crouch; extend hind legs in powerful forward-left horn charge; plant forelegs and raise neck

machine_saw_wheel.description: mechanical saw-wheel pursuer reference left column
machine_saw_wheel.action: pull both metal claw arms back and compress wheel suspension; extend mechanical claw arms strongly forward-left and clamp pincers; retract arms and raise suspension

machine_mortar_tripod.description: three-legged mortar robot reference middle column
machine_mortar_tripod.action: spread three feet and tilt barrel up-back; fire toward left with barrel recoil and small muzzle flash; return barrel halfway level

machine_foundry_ogre.description: heavy foundry mechanical ogre reference right column
machine_foundry_ogre.action: raise massive striking arm above shoulder and bend knees; smash arm down-left with torso folding; pull hammering arm halfway back

nebula_quartz_scorpion.description: quartz-tailed crystalline scorpion reference left column
nebula_quartz_scorpion.action: curl tail high behind back and spread pincers; whip stinger far forward-left over head; uncurl tail halfway back

nebula_comet_cuttlefish.action: curl tentacles backward and inflate mantle; shoot tentacles forward-left with a small astral ink jet; retract tentacles and relax mantle

nebula_crown_manta.description: star-crowned hovering manta reference right column
nebula_crown_manta.action: raise broad fins high and draw head back; sweep fins down and extend head leftward with a compact star pulse; bring fins half-up

core_rune_leech.action: coil body into short spring and open mouth; elongate body toward left with jaws wide; curl head back into coil

core_bound_grimoire.description: bound arcane grimoire monster reference middle column
core_bound_grimoire.action: close covers partly and fold pages inward; fling covers wide and thrust pages left with a small cyan magical burst; fold covers inward halfway

core_horned_ram.description: arcane-core horned ram reference right column
core_horned_ram.action: lower curved horns and crouch hind legs; charge head-first leftwards with hind legs extended; plant hooves and lift head

boss_flood_anchor_admiral.description: colossal drowned armored admiral with huge anchor weapon in reference top-left
boss_flood_anchor_admiral.action: draw enormous anchor up and back with bending elbows; sweep anchor down-left into a crushing blow, torso leans; haul anchor halfway back

boss_spore_threefold_hydra.description: colossal three-headed mushroom hydra in reference top-middle, EXACTLY three heads preserved in every pose
boss_spore_threefold_hydra.action: draw all three necks backward and crouch body; thrust all three heads forward-left with open jaws; curl three necks halfway back

boss_lava_caldera_drake.description: colossal volcanic winged drake in reference top-right, two hind legs plus two wing arms, no extra limbs
boss_lava_caldera_drake.action: rear neck high, bend hind legs and sweep wings up; drive head and neck forward-left exhaling short compact flame, wings sweep down; pull head up and fold wings halfway

boss_machine_siege_engine.description: colossal mechanical siege executioner from reference bottom-left, preserve its actual weapon assembly
boss_machine_siege_engine.action: raise its enormous crushing weapon assembly high with pistons contracting; drive weapon hard down-forward-left, chassis braced; retract pistons and lift weapon halfway

boss_nebula_starwhale.description: colossal cosmic star whale from reference bottom-middle
boss_nebula_starwhale.action: arch whole back and draw jaws back while fins rise; open vast jaws and thrust head forward-left with compact starlight breath; close mouth partly and sweep fins back

boss_core_crowned_wraith.description: colossal crowned arcane wraith from reference bottom-right, EXACTLY four arms in all poses
boss_core_crowned_wraith.action: fold all four arms inward gathering cyan power; thrust lower pair leftwards and spread upper pair casting a small cyan pulse; draw all four arms back halfway

thorn_maw.description: a carnivorous walking pitcher plant with four thick root legs, a large hinged thorn-lined flower mouth, dark green leaves and coral-red inner petals
thorn_maw.action: close jaw and compress stem; snap jaws forward and spit a compact lime sap glob left; close jaw and fold petals

briar_stag.description: a lean four-legged bark-armored deer with branching thorn antlers, moss shoulders and amber eyes, no humanoid arms
briar_stag.action: brace all four legs and lower antlers; extend hind legs in a low antler thrust left; plant hooves and lift head

acorn_slinger.description: a mischievous russet squirrel with a huge curled tail, leaf hood, acorn satchel and a small wooden slingshot held in two paws
acorn_slinger.action: pull slingshot pouch back with an acorn; release one acorn leftward while paws recoil; lower slingshot and reach toward satchel

bone_serpent.description: a limbless skeletal serpent with a hornless snake skull, articulated ivory vertebrae, rib plates and green eye sockets, one tapering tail
bone_serpent.action: coil neck into S and open jaw; extend neck left in a long snapping bite; recoil neck and close jaw

grave_lantern.description: a compact floating teal ghost wearing a ragged hood, two spectral arms holding a black iron grave lantern with blue flame, no legs or weapons
grave_lantern.action: raise lantern with both spectral hands and concentrate its flame; swing lantern forward left emitting a short blue flame pulse; bring lantern back to chest

coffin_mimic.description: a short upright wooden coffin creature with two bent iron legs, two claw arms, brass handles and an enormous toothed split lid mouth, dark purple tongue
coffin_mimic.action: bend legs and shut lid tightly; fling lid-jaws open and lunge left with tongue visible; close lid halfway and settle legs

sand_mummy.description: a wrapped mummy warrior with tattered ochre bandages, dark eye sockets glowing turquoise and one bronze khopesh curved sword, exactly two arms and two legs
sand_mummy.action: raise khopesh behind shoulder and bend knees; sweep curved blade forward left with one compact pale slash; draw sword back into low guard

glass_cobra.description: a limbless golden cobra with a wide hood inlaid with translucent turquoise glass scales and a single tapering tail, amber eyes
glass_cobra.action: rear head and expand hood; thrust open jaws left and spit a tiny turquoise venom droplet; retract head and narrow hood

dune_sphinx.description: a muscular four-legged tawny lion sphinx with sandstone armor plates, two folded hawk wings and a blue-gold pharaoh collar, feline face
dune_sphinx.action: crouch hind legs and lift nearer front paw; rake the front paw forward left while wings brace; place paw down and fold wings

frost_penguin.description: a stout navy-white penguin with a jagged ice crest, orange feet, pale blue scarf and one rough ice pebble held in a flipper
frost_penguin.action: pull pebble-bearing flipper behind body; swing flipper forward tossing one ice pebble leftward; lower flipper and recover balance

glacier_walrus.description: a stocky grey-blue walrus quadruped on four broad flippers with two huge ice-coated tusks and snow-crusted shoulders, no weapon
glacier_walrus.action: lower head and brace foreflippers; thrust both tusks forward left with body weight; lift head and settle foreflippers

snow_wisp.description: a floating round white snow spirit with a small ice-mask face, two wispy arms, a swirling snow-cone lower body and light cyan crystal crown
snow_wisp.action: curl both wispy arms inward compressing a snowball; stretch arms left releasing compact icy gust; arms loosen and lower swirl relaxes

abyss_angler.description: a squat deep-navy anglerfish beast walking on two sturdy rear fins and two broad side fins, huge toothed jaw, one glowing amber lure on forehead and tiny pale eyes
abyss_angler.action: brace fins and pull head back, lure folds backward; snap enormous jaws forward left with fins extended; close jaws halfway and lower lure

abyss_urchin.description: a low round dark-indigo sea urchin monster with many short ivory spines, six tiny tube feet and two bright amber eyes, three longer dorsal spines
abyss_urchin.action: crouch tube feet and point three long spines left; launch one short ivory spine left while remaining spines recoil; extend feet and reset spine fan

coral_mantis.description: a compact orange-teal mantis shrimp with segmented curling tail, six tiny walking legs and two oversized folded coral-pink punching forelimbs, stalked eyes
coral_mantis.action: fold one striking forelimb tightly near face; unfold it explosively left with small white impact spark; retract punching limb into guard

magnetic_orb.description: a hovering brass spherical core between two large horseshoe-shaped iron magnet arms, blue central eye, two small floating iron chunks, no legs
magnetic_orb.action: pull magnet arms and iron chunks inward around eye; extend magnet arms left and launch one iron chunk with brief blue arc; pull magnet arms back and orbit the remaining chunk

bronze_centipede.description: a low bronze mechanical centipede with six articulated armored body segments, twelve short jointed legs, two large steel mandibles and red lens eyes, one tapered tail
bronze_centipede.action: coil front two segments and spread mandibles; extend front body left snapping mandibles closed; bend neck and spread front legs to recover

steam_scarecrow.description: a lanky copper automaton with a broad patched metal farm hat, two segmented arms, two reverse-jointed legs, one curved iron sickle and a small shoulder steam pipe, glowing orange slit face
steam_scarecrow.action: bend knees and pull sickle arm behind shoulder; sweep sickle left while free arm counterbalances and pipe releases tiny puff; retract sickle to waist and straighten legs

moss_owlbear.description: a huge two-legged owl-headed bear with two powerful clawed arms, moss-green feathers, ivory beak and amber eyes
moss_owlbear.action: raise right claw behind shoulder; sweep claw low to screen left with a short ivory arc; fold arm back

geode_pangolin.description: a low four-legged pangolin, layered dark slate scales with embedded amber geodes, long thick armored tail and small pointed head
geode_pangolin.action: coil tail beside its body; swing tail to screen left with sharp hip rotation; settle tail behind

chain_jailer.description: a hollow iron jailer armor with barred cage helmet and teal inner eye, two arms two legs, one short heavy chain ending in a square iron weight
chain_jailer.action: pull chain weight behind right shoulder; throw weight to screen left with fully extended arm, chain contained in cell; pull weight back

cinder_bison.description: a massive four-legged charcoal bison with a high ember-cracked shoulder hump, short curved brass horns and orange glowing nostrils
cinder_bison.action: lower head and brace front hooves; thrust horns left and extend hind legs; lift head and plant hooves

rime_lynx.description: a four-legged snow lynx with blue-gray spotted fur, tufted ears, two curved ice fangs and short tail
rime_lynx.action: crouch with left front paw folded; slash left paw forward to screen left with a short cyan arc; retract paw and stand

dune_djinn.description: a turquoise two-armed djinn torso rising from a small ochre amphora, gold cuffs and white turban, lower body narrow sand spiral attached to amphora, no legs
dune_djinn.action: draw both palms near chest holding compact sand ball; thrust both palms left releasing a small ochre sand orb; retract palms

species.description: a huge two-legged owl-headed bear with two powerful clawed arms, moss-green feathers, ivory beak and amber eyes
species.action: raise right claw behind shoulder; sweep claw low to screen left with a short ivory arc; fold arm back

species.description: a low four-legged pangolin, layered dark slate scales with embedded amber geodes, long thick armored tail and small pointed head
species.action: coil tail beside its body; swing tail to screen left with sharp hip rotation; settle tail behind

species.description: a hollow iron jailer armor with barred cage helmet and teal inner eye, two arms two legs, one short heavy chain ending in a square iron weight
species.action: pull chain weight behind right shoulder; throw weight to screen left with fully extended arm, chain contained in cell; pull weight back

species.description: a massive four-legged charcoal bison with a high ember-cracked shoulder hump, short curved brass horns and orange glowing nostrils
species.action: lower head and brace front hooves; thrust horns left and extend hind legs; lift head and plant hooves

species.description: a four-legged snow lynx with blue-gray spotted fur, tufted ears, two curved ice fangs and short tail
species.action: crouch with left front paw folded; slash left paw forward to screen left with a short cyan arc; retract paw and stand

species.description: a turquoise two-armed djinn torso rising from a small ochre amphora, gold cuffs and white turban, lower body narrow sand spiral attached to amphora, no legs
species.action: draw both palms near chest holding compact sand ball; thrust both palms left releasing a small ochre sand orb; retract palms

packs.additional_theme_policy: ruins/desert do not replace existing 100-floor chapters
